hood.basis: 1993 Workshop Manual Body S-5/S-6 confirms rear-cowl hinges and upward front opening. Exact customized pivot remains the estimated transverse axis through the measured source bonnet rear edge; no fabricated hinge or inner reinforcement.

validation.method: Full-resolution triangle BVH followed by bidirectional normal-projected triangle-footprint clipping. Report the smaller positive/negative surface height inside the actual overlap; shared edges and coplanar contacts approach zero.
validation.limitation: These are bounded surface crossings, not signed penetration volumes: hood and lamp-cover meshes are open/nonmanifold. Ray-parity inside depths are invalid for those surfaces and are deliberately not used. Full pose sweep remains blocked by measurable source intersections, not merely contact counts.

axisCandidates.decision: Keep measured rear-edge axis. Millimetric axis offsets do not repair intersections already present at the closed pose; downward/forward offsets introduce additional roof-frame contacts. No alternate axis is certified.

assemblyAssessment.sourceStationBasis: Exact source Aero_Kit A-pillar band vertices, paired across windshield-edge and outer-edge at lower/middle/upper stations. Source Body_Shell contains an additional inner surface; both layers retained.

sectionComparison.method: Ray sections through complete source surfaces, normal to measured source A-pillar band, at seven longitudinal stations and three transverse positions.

preserved: original 16 vertices and 32 triangles per pillar
straightReembeddingTrial.decision: Rejected: a 313 mm re-layout is not a millimetric envelope correction, and straight re-embedding still intersects the inner source shell. Trial was never written to delivered GLB or Blend.

minimumNeeded: A source-aligned inner A-pillar section/centreline compatible with both retained exterior layers and the source cowl endpoint; the current estimated straight member extends forward under the hood.

Permission to rebuild those two reference-layout members from measured cross-sections, with documented changed geometry, or a corrected supplied CAD pair. A silent hide or arbitrary large translation is not a valid repair.

A corrected source closed-headlight/bonnet boundary if no visible intersections through the opening sweep is mandatory; current source surfaces already cross by multiple millimetres in the closed pose.
assemblyAssessment.limits: Measurements locate conflicts in the supplied reference reconstruction. They do not establish OEM cross-sections, hinge points or manufacturing dimensions.

rendering.instruction: Materials with extras.sourceFlatShading must use per-face flat shading. Three.js GLTFLoader does this when NORMAL is absent; explicitly retain material.flatShading=true. Never compute smooth vertex normals. Exterior NORMAL accessors are unchanged.
rendering.shaderPrecision: Geometric face normals from unchanged float32 positions; microscopic sliver-normal numerical differences are recorded per asset.

silver.instruction: Restore each material's originalBaseColor from GLB extras; retain its map, COLOR_0, metallic, roughness and clearcoat. Do not replace silver with a guessed swatch.

paint.selection: material.extras.paint === true, not whole part, mesh or car

mask.method: Conservative per-polygon material split by inspected source UV atlas. Both paint and fixed copies retain the original shader graph; no texture rebake.
mask.mixedOrUncertainFaces: remain fixed; original dark details, lamps, glass, plates, rims and exhaust are never globally tinted
mask.limitation: Conservative atlas-based coverage, not an OEM coating segmentation; uncertain source atlas islands are intentionally not recoloured.
